name: Source Tag
description: LOW CORNER. The citation for a fact whose source the narration names: one thin rule draws out from the corner, then 'SOURCE: USBR, 2024' rises under it in small tracked caps (label = 'Source'; text = the source as said, or the short form viewers know; subtitle = the year, only when the narration says it). No box, no band: white on the picture with a soft shadow. It holds still and leaves in its last 9 frames. align left / right picks the corner; with captions on it sits clear above them. Silent. Placed only by the planner's source pass (src/sources.py, config.SOURCE_TAGS): a source is never invented, a figure with no named source gets no tag.
